_comment: Single source for the store-shot pipeline (config, spec, frame.mjs, play-assets.mjs).
frame.mjs breaks a caption after its first separator (, 、 ， 。 . ! ? ،) and highlights the first line.
captions.*.my: MY-tab frame (not in the listing docs; drafted 2026-11-02, approved by the coordinator 2026-11-03), naming the tab as each locale's tab.settings does.
names / short: docs/03c section 0 (app name rule '<local film camera> - Film Camela').
